title: Big Button Phone for Seniors, 9 Pictured Big Buttons,Extra Loud Ringer,Wired
descriptionText: The Big Button Phone for Seniors is a corded telephone with 9 pictured big buttons for easy dialing. It features an extra loud ringer and single-line operation, making it ideal for those who require a simple and straightforward phone. The phone is designed with a single keypad dialer and is powered by a corded electric source. With a compact size of 8.9x8.86x2.72 inches and a weight of 1.59 pounds, this white phone is made of durable acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) material, providing a reliable communication option for seniors.
